panel_profile_switch.result: passed: held Quest MR Gamepad remains disconnected and unchanged through Android AR inputs
panel_profile_switch.method: Retain a held Quest MR source/Gamepad, switch to Android through the actual DevTools panel, capture final sample at session end, then run Android sessions and two real simulated-screen gestures; verify no reconnection/update and retained metadata identity.

count_semantics: Focused assertions count executed checks, including repeated final-state retention checks across sources/frames. Distinct labels are recorded separately. Existing core conformance uses distinct labels; suite counts are separate, not a combined total.

policy.metadata: Snapshot handedness, ray mode, ordered profiles and Gamepad presence. Public getters are readonly, profiles is a frozen array, spaces stay stable and skipRendering is false. Metadata changes replace source in one old/new change event after collection update; buttons/axes keep identity.
policy.gamepad: One live SameObject exposure per active Quest source. Empty ID, index -1, xr-standard, placeholder axes/buttons and digital touched/pressed/value preserved. Removal/replacement/end permanently disconnects and retains the final sampled axes/buttons/timestamp; later input/reconnection/session/profile cannot mutate it.
policy.touch_and_spaces: One source per gesture; added/selectstart/select/selectend/removed order. Release-event poses remain valid; retired target-ray/grip/joint spaces return null in their session, foreign-session spaces and inactive frames reject.

wpt_adaptation.execution: Focused adapted assertions in tests/input-lifecycle.ts; not verbatim WPT execution.
wpt_adaptation.substitutions: Native fake-device connection, metadata setters, supported-button/Gamepad-presence changes and disconnect/reconnect are replaced by temporary metadata getters on the real adapter, controller activation and state updates. All getter descriptors are restored. No production testing API. Phone gestures use real simulated-screen mouse handlers; the actual panel drives profile switching.
wpt_adaptation.normative_discrepancies: Prior grip/mapping assumptions corrected for the synthetic gaze transition as recorded below. Final-sample retention is selected emulator policy, not a universal allocation requirement. No other discrepancy found in the adapted assertions.

correction_provenance.original_assumption: Sharing adapter Gamepads proved universally distinct cross-session allocation was mandatory.
correction_provenance.corrected_requirement: SameObject within each source and coherent source-lifetime isolation. Per-source wrappers/permanent retirement are implementation policy, not a universally mandated allocation rule.
correction_provenance.rationale: The 7 July 2025 WD specifies SameObject and connection/frame updates without explicitly mandating distinct allocation for every session. The published alias identifies that exact publication; dated URL was unavailable.

correction_provenance.original_assumption: All non-screen sources have a grip and all controller Gamepads use xr-standard.
correction_provenance.corrected_requirement: Nontrackable gaze and screen sources have null grips. xr-standard requires tracked-pointer and a non-null grip; gaze fixture Gamepads use empty mapping.
correction_provenance.rationale: The metadata recreation fixture exposed existing getter/mapping assumptions. Correcting them preserves supported Quest/Android mapping/nullability and acceptance. Gaze remains a test fixture, not a new selectable device. No Issue requirement was weakened.
correction_provenance.publication: Recorded in capability inventory and prepared PR text; no GitHub edits/comments were authorized for this node.

resolved_validation_failures.failure: First browser attempt failed in the new axis fixture: _updateInputAxes received arguments in the wrong order and tried to read an undefined Gamepad.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: Use the actual (controllerIndex, x, y) signature. Subsequent full runs pass.

resolved_validation_failures.failure: Second attempt passed Quest VR/MR focused suites, then the new panel profile-switch probe created a WebGL context without XR compatibility; XRWebGLLayer rejected with InvalidStateError.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: Create the probe context with xrCompatible: true, as in the existing runner. Subsequent full runs pass.

review_adjustments: Capture the panel-switch Gamepad final sample in the end listener, since a live frame can advance before the panel message arrives. This prevents a timing-dependent false failure.
Inspect connection state inside inputsourceschange listeners as well as subsequent frames, adapting the WPT event-time disconnection assertions.
